errors.text_span: както и на Русия и България
errors.evidence: The chart does not include Russia. The country code 'RO' represents Romania, not Russia.
The bars are sorted in descending order of their total value, not alphabetically. For example, FI (Finland) is first, followed by DK (Denmark).
The vertical axis represents values from 0 to 80, not 0 to 70.

errors.text_span: Стойностите са етикетирани с интервали от 5
errors.evidence: The values on the y-axis are labeled at intervals of 10, not 5.
The second category in the legend is "2 Свързаност" (Connectivity), not "Въвеждане на цифрови технологии".
This category does not exist in the legend. The third category is "3 Внедряване на цифрови технологии" (Integration of digital technology).

errors.text_span: Височината на всеки стълб отразява стойността на всяка съответна категория за дадената държава.
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect description for a stacked bar chart. The height of the entire bar represents the total value across all categories, while the height of each colored segment represents the value for its specific category.
The description fails to mention the primary purpose of the chart, which is a "Класация" (Ranking) of countries, as clearly stated in the title.
The description fails to identify the chart as a stacked bar chart, a fundamental structural property needed to understand how the different categories contribute to the total.
The chart displays 27 countries (most of which are EU members) plus an aggregate bar for the EU average; it does not explicitly show 28 member states.
The description omits that the bar for Bulgaria (BG) is highlighted with a rectangular box, which is a deliberate visual emphasis.
